Contract ManageLoanTermCRUDService::queryLoanTerm(itemid: Integer): LoanTerm {
	definition:
		obsLoanTerm: LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(o|o.ItemID = itemid)
	precondition:
		currentLoanRequest.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		LoanTerm.allInstance()->exists(o|o.ItemID = itemid)
	postcondition:
		currentLoanRequest.AttachedLoanTerms->includes(obsLoanTerm) and
		result = obsLoanTerm
}
